heroMockup: Lesson plan for one role (the site's sample Operations track, four modules with lab lines and a role picker), then a practice exercise where a participant reviews an AI draft of their own weekly report against a checklist, then a short AI usage rules sheet pinned into the exercise. No other unit uses the curriculum + lab + policy combination; no chat-with-agent, no approval card.
sourceOfClaims: src/i18n/units/academy.ts (hero, pains, offers, method, faq, cta) and src/components/unit/AcademyExplorer/copy.ts (Operations track modules, lab text, 90/60 min module times, role names). Review checklist items come from the blog post training-teams-on-ai ('numbers match the source; exceptions flagged') and its FAQ (a human reviews output before it leaves the company). Timelines used only as stated: Assess 1 week, Tailor 1-2 weeks, Train 1 day to 6 weeks, Follow up after training; Leadership program 4-6 weeks; Enablement 6-12 weeks. Mock report text contains no figures. No stats, clients or results.

Nadie les mostró qué hacer con ella.
